summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a 424B5 preliminary pricing supplement for a registered offering of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due August 2, 2032, linked to the worst-performing of the Nasdaq-100 Index and the Russell 2000 Index. The notes are unsecured senior obligations issued under its Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program, with a stated principal amount of $1,000 per note, quarterly contingent coupon payments of $26.88, and autocall feature beginning July 29, 2027. The filing is a routine debt securities takedown from an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. No special-situation category applies — this is an ordinary structured note offering.
